title: Su-30MKI (India, pilot)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The Su-30MKI is the Indian Air Force's version of the two-seat Flanker, with canards, thrust vectoring and a tandem glass cockpit using Israeli, French and Indian avionics (Sextant displays). Its cockpit and controls are taken as those of the Su-30SM, so this guide follows the Su-30SM guide.
